statement.p: Find a formula for the trigonometric function graphed below. Use x as the independent variable in your formula.

static.solution:
SOLUTION
This function resembles a sine curve in that the graph is at its midline when x = 0. We know that the smallest value it attains is -0.8, that its midline is y = 0, so its amplitude is 0.8. Thus in the equation f(x) = A \sin{(Bx)} + k we know that A = 0.8 and k = 0. Since the graph has a period of \frac{\pi}{18}, the value for B = \frac{2 \pi}{\mbox{period}} = \frac{2 \pi}{\pi/18} = 2 \cdot 18 = 36. Finally we have a formula: f(x) = 0.8 \sin{(36 x)}.
